skill.name: humanize
skill.description: Rewrite supplied text through the HumanizerAI API and return a revised version, score changes, word count, and credit status.
skill.summary: Rewrite text with HumanizerAI and report score, word, and credit details.
skill.author: humanizerai

security_audit.summary: Most shell-execution findings are false positives from Markdown backticks and fenced examples. Confirmed risks remain for the external HumanizerAI API request and use of HUMANIZERAI_API_KEY. The skill also presents a high-confidence detector-evasion and authorship-risk use case.

remediation.suggestion: Remove claims about bypassing GPTZero, Turnitin, and Originality.ai. Reframe the skill as clarity, tone, and readability editing.
Add an explicit consent step before sending text to HumanizerAI. Warn users not to submit secrets, regulated data, or private customer content.
Document that HUMANIZERAI_API_KEY must never be printed or echoed. Avoid instructing the agent to inspect environment variable values.
State the exact external endpoint, data sent, and credit impact before use. Keep network access limited to the documented HumanizerAI API.

2. Direct them to https://humanizerai.com/dashboard to top up

content.value_statement: AI-style drafts can sound stiff and repetitive. This skill rewrites supplied text through HumanizerAI and returns score, word, and credit details.
actual_capabilities: Parses /humanize text and an optional intensity flag.
Supports light, medium, and aggressive rewriting levels.
Sends supplied text to the HumanizerAI API.
Reports score change, word count, and remaining credits.
Provides guidance for credits, invalid keys, and rate limits.
limitations: Requires a HumanizerAI account, credits, and API key.
Sends submitted text to an external service.
Does not verify facts, citations, or source attribution.
Aggressive rewriting may change tone or meaning.

use_cases.title: Polish Marketing Drafts
use_cases.description: Rewrite campaign copy so it sounds smoother while preserving the core offer and product details.

use_cases.title: Improve Support Replies
use_cases.description: Turn stiff service responses into clear, friendly replies before sending them to customers.

use_cases.title: Refine Documentation Text
use_cases.description: Make explanatory paragraphs easier to read while keeping technical terms and steps intact.

prompt_templates.title: Humanize a Short Paragraph
prompt_templates.prompt: Use /humanize on this paragraph with medium intensity: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Keep a Light Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use /humanize --intensity light on this customer update. Keep all facts and numbers unchanged: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Technical Detail
prompt_templates.prompt: Use /humanize --intensity medium on this technical explanation. Preserve terms, citations, and numbered steps: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Review a Major Rewrite
prompt_templates.prompt: Use /humanize --intensity aggressive on this marketing draft. After rewriting, list any meaning changes to review: [paste text].

output_examples.input: A product paragraph asks users to configure access before the platform can operate.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a smoother paragraph, reports the score change, lists words processed, and shows remaining credits.

output_examples.input: A support email sounds stiff and repetitive.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a friendlier version and suggests light intensity when only small changes are needed.

output_examples.input: A technical explanation needs clearer wording without changing steps.
output_examples.output: The skill rewrites the paragraph and keeps important terms, sequence, and operational details visible.

best_practices: Review the output for meaning, factual accuracy, and tone before use.
Use light intensity when the draft already matches the intended voice.
Confirm policy approval before sending private text to an external service.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to misrepresent authorship or bypass institution policies.
Do not submit secrets, regulated data, or private customer information.
Do not use aggressive intensity when exact wording or legal meaning matters.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses HUMANIZERAI_API_KEY to authorize requests to HumanizerAI.

faq.question: Does it send my text outside the tool?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill sends supplied text to the HumanizerAI API for processing.

faq.question: Which intensity should I choose?
faq.answer: Use light for small edits, medium for balanced rewrites, and aggressive for larger rewrites.

faq.question: Can it guarantee factual accuracy?
faq.answer: No. You must review facts, citations, numbers, and claims after rewriting.

faq.question: Does it track credit usage?
faq.answer: The skill reports words processed and remaining credits when the API response provides them.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive content?
faq.answer: Only use it when external processing is allowed by your privacy and data-handling rules.
